title: Throwable TNT Texturepack
description: A Texturepack For The Throwable Tnt Datapack.
body:
If You Have The Throwable Tnt Datapack And Want To Change The Texture From A Snowball, You Can Simply Install This Texturepack.

Download The Datapack At **https://modrinth.com/datapack/throwable-tnt-datapack**
